lines.text: Wisdom builds her house, carves out her twelve pillars, prepares her meat and wine, and sends out her maidservants.
Wisdom invites the simple to eat her bread and drink her wine, and to leave their folly behind and live.
Rebuking a mocker brings shame and hatred, but a wise man who is rebuked will love you.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and through wisdom your days will be multiplied.
Folly sits at her door and calls the simple with stolen water, but her guests are in Hades.
